selection.reason: The front bumper fascia, EPP absorber and lower stiffener set the lower/upper legform impact results that R127 tests on the M1 front end.
R42 covers the behaviour of front protective devices of M1 vehicles in low-speed collisions, which is the bumper's energy-management function.
As an outer surface of an M1 vehicle, the fascia, grille, plate holder, towing cover and sensor housings must meet R26 limits on external projections and radii.
The bumper beam/lower stiffener and absorber are part of the front crash structure that affects the offset frontal impact test result.
The front energy-management structure of the bumper contributes to the crash pulse in the full-width frontal impact test of M1 vehicles.
The integrated radar, LIDAR with heating, camera, PDC sensors, pedestrian impact sensors, lighting electronics and keyless aerial are electrical/electronic sub-assemblies subject to EMC requirements.
The integrated side signalling lamps (e.g. direction indicators, side marker, position or daytime running lamps) are light-signalling devices requiring component approval under the consolidated R148.
R48 governs the position, visibility and wiring of signalling lamps mounted in the bumper and prohibits or restricts decorative lighting on M1 vehicles.
The EV charge port housed in the bumper must provide the protection against direct contact and the charging-inlet safety required for electric power trains.
verworfen (Annahme, nicht in der Spec): If the 'functional' lighting in the bumper includes front fog lamps or cornering lamps, these road illumination devices need R149 approval.
verworfen (Annahme, nicht in der Spec): If the bumper-mounted radar/camera serve the AEBS, their mounting and field of view influence compliance of the M1 AEBS approval.
verworfen (Annahme, nicht in der Spec): If the bumper sensors feed a driver control assistance system, the DCAS approval relies on their sensing performance.
verworfen (Annahme, nicht in der Spec): If the bumper camera/radar support ACSF or corrective steering functions, these are approved under R79.
verworfen (Annahme, nicht in der Spec): If the bumper radar/LIDAR are used by an automated lane keeping system, R157 sensing requirements depend on them.
verworfen (Annahme, nicht in der Spec): If the PDC/forward sensors provide the forward detection for acceleration control for pedal error, R175 applies to the M1 vehicle.
verworfen (nur Fahrzeugebene): The connected ECUs in the bumper (radar, camera, keyless aerial) fall under the vehicle's cyber security management and approval.
verworfen (Annahme, nicht in der Spec): If the bumper's sensor ECUs are software-updatable, their updates fall under the vehicle's software update management system.
verworfen (Annahme, nicht in der Spec): The keyless-entry aerial forms part of the vehicle's access/unauthorized-use protection system assessed under R161.
